products_list.name: 22k English Gold Sovereign Coin Lira

Whether for investment or as a collector's piece, the English Sovereign offers a perfect blend of historical significance, durability, and intrinsic value.

products_list.name: 21k English Half Mkhamas Coin
products_list.description:
The 21K English Half Mkhamas (often referred to in Arabic as Nisf Mukhamas Injeleezi - نصف مخمس إنجليزي) is one of the most prestigious and recognizable gold coin designs across Middle Eastern and Levantine markets. Based on the world-famous British Sovereign motif, this coin features the legendary image of Saint George slaying the Dragon.

While standard sovereigns are individual coin units, the Half Mkhamas format represents a 2.5-unit size (equivalent in scale to 2.5 standard English sovereigns). Struck in rich 21K (.875 Fine) Gold, this coin medallion offers an impressive weight and diameter, making it a standout centerpiece for wearable coin necklaces (Kordana), bridal sets, and bullion collections.

products_list.name: 21k Turkish Mkhamas (Rashadi)
products_list.description: Immerse yourself in Ottoman heritage with this exquisite 35-gram Turkish Mkhamas, also known as the Rashadi. Crafted in rich 21-karat gold, this substantial coin features intricate calligraphy and traditional patterns reflecting the artistry of a bygone era. Weighing an impressive 35 grams, it is a treasured piece for both its cultural significance and its solid investment value, perfect for adornment or as a centerpiece in any gold collection

products_list.name: 21k Turkish Half Mkhamas (Rashadi)
products_list.description:
Steeped in rich Ottoman history and regional tradition, the 21K Turkish Half Mkhamas (Rashadi) is one of the most prestigious gold pieces in Middle Eastern and Levantine jewelry traditions. Inspired by the historic Reşat Lira coins minted during the reign of Ottoman Sultan Mehmed V Reşad, the Mkhamas (derived from the Arabic word for five) represents a multi-Lira weight class.

The Half Mkhamas (Nisf Mukhamas) corresponds to the 2.5 Lira size, offering a substantial, impressive gold piece struck in 21K (.875 Fine) Gold. Celebrated for its intricate calligraphic artwork and high gold content, it serves as both a high-liquidity gold store and a cherished bridal or family heirloom.

products_list.name: 21k Palestine Gold Coin
products_list.description:
Celebrate heritage and elegance with our stunning 21k Gold Palestine Coin. This exquisite piece is meticulously crafted with a rich, warm yellow gold hue that radiates timeless beauty.

The obverse features the intricate and beautifully textured outline of Palestine, framed by elegant olive branches at the base, and adorned with the Arabic inscription "دولة فلسطين" (State of Palestine) gracefully curved along the top.

On the reverse, a central, detailed olive branch design—a universal symbol of peace and resilience—takes center stage. It is elegantly topped with "PALESTINE" in bold English lettering, while the year "1927" and its Arabic equivalent rest perfectly at the bottom.

Perfect for collectors, as a meaningful gift, or as a proud symbol of identity, this beautifully detailed and polished 21-karat gold coin is a true masterpiece.

products_list.name: Mexican 50 Pesos Gold Lira - The Centenario
products_list.description: First minted in 1921 to commemorate the centennial of Mexico's independence from Spain, the 50 Pesos 'Centenario' is one of the most beautiful and substantial gold bullion coins in the world. It features the breathtaking 'Winged Victory' (Angel of Independence) on the obverse and the Mexican Coat of Arms on the reverse. With a gold content of 1.2057 troy ounces (37.5 grams of pure gold) and a purity of 90% (21.6 karat), this large, historic coin is a prestigious addition to any portfolio.
